name: Big Mike's Steakhouse
subtitle: Voted #1 Ribeye in the State of Alabama by Alabama Cattlemen's Association!
description: Big Mike's Steakhouse is a casual steakhouse that serves Certified Angus Beef and has been voted Alabama's Best Steak by the Alabama Cattlemen's Association. With multiple locations across Alabama, we offer a first-come, first-serve dining experience with full bars at each location. We specialize in premium steaks and offer weekly chef features, private parties, and catering services with custom grilling available for off-site events.
